instruction.text: Select the word ealdormen to learn more about them.
instruction.sound: Select the word uldermen to learn more about them.

atoms.b: Ealdormen were nobles who looked after the ((++land space_ships)) in a kingdom.
atoms.sound: Uldermen were nobles who looked after the land in a kingdom.

atoms.b: Their duties included enforcing the law and raising ((++armies puppies)) for war.
atoms.sound: Their duties included enforcing the law and raising armies for war.

instruction.text: What kind of armour do you think an ealdorman would have worn in battle?
instruction.sound: What kind of armour do you think an ulderman would have worn in battle?

correct.text: Ealdormen were high ranking, and often royalty, so they would have worn the best armour available.
correct.sound: Uldermen were high ranking, and often royalty, so they would have worn the best armour available.

instruction.text: Select the word thegns to learn more about them.
instruction.sound: Select the word thanes to learn more about them.

atoms.b: The thegns were warriors and ((++bodyguards pilots)) who served a king or an ealdorman in return for land.
atoms.sound: The thanes were warriors and bodyguards who served a king or an ulderman in return for land.

atoms.b: In times of peace, their service would also include fixing ((++roads phones)) and bridges.
atoms.sound: In times of peace, their service would also include fixing roads and bridges.

instruction.text: What kind of cloth do you think a thegn would have worn day-to-day?
instruction.sound: What kind of cloth do you think a thane would have worn day-to-day?

wrong.text: The very finest cloth would have been saved for kings, aethelings and ealdormen.
wrong.sound: The very finest cloth would have been saved for kings, ethellings and uldermen.

correct.text: Thegns would have had access to good quality cloth and some basic armour.
correct.sound: Thanes would have had access to good quality cloth and some basic armour.

instruction.text: Select the new part of the diagram to learn more about religious orders in Anglo-Saxon society.

atoms.b: Bishops and priests were separate in society, as they were ((++members fans)) of the Church.
atoms.sound: Bishops and priests were separate in society, as they were members of the Church.

atoms.b: They were roughly on the same level as ((++ealdormen kings)) and thegns respectively.
atoms.sound: They were roughly on the same level as uldermen and thanes respectively.

instruction.text: Select St Patrick’s crosier to learn more.

hint.label: Crosier
hint.text: A crosier is the stick held by a bishop. They normally have a curved and ornate top.
hint.sound: A krozier is the stick held by a bishop. They normally have a curved and ornate top.

feedback.end: Bishops and priests dressed differently to the rest of society — as they still do today. In this painting, St Patrick is shown in his religious robes.
